The doc is wrong, or the arm is missing. Either way, the message you just touched contradicts the doc four lines above it.
2. This arm echoes `t` (trimmed), while the hex arm at line 45 echoes `s` (untrimmed). A given input is never both, but "reported as typed" would read more honestly if both arms used the same variable (`s`).
